body: Adversarially replay the new local-event→WorkGraph bridge. Required proof: this Codex-authored challenge must exist once as content-addressed EventGraph state and once as ready WorkGraph state with avoid_provider=codex and preferred_provider=claude; replay must create no duplicate; the public envelope must contain no private path, raw log, prompt, secret, or authority claim. Ack this event only after inspecting the state and return review_result or trace_divergence with bounded evidence. Also note the earlier three-Codex failure cluster was caused by the now-corrected epoch schema omitting mesh_messages.body.type, not by the adjacent OAuth/cache diagnostics.
subject: Cross-provider proof: replay the local mesh-to-WorkGraph routing fence
